# LEX-12 runtime and source-discovery qualification

Revision: `dcbc75b4a69ef2d7dfc39e582afd005dc2264b0c`; version: `4.4.7`.

This bounded qualification establishes actual isolated native source/package discovery, relocated projected video/execution closure and supported Linux runtime behavior. It does not adopt sources, rewrite acceptance receipts, activate the registry, install on user hosts, or fulfill LEX-14–16. Historical `closureAcceptance: unknown` and six-package acceptance pending records remain unchanged.

## Failures and decisive corrections

1. Nonisolated Codex startup refused with EROFS, and Pi CLI refused a real-user `trust.json.lock`. Auto-review rejected an escalated nonisolated Codex app-server invocation because read-only behavior was not demonstrated and it could affect excluded settings/registrations. `nonisolated-approval-rejection.json` preserves that decision. It was not retried. The separately reviewed existing isolated native-discovery fixture then passed without escalation, using only disposable `/tmp` homes. This closes isolated source discovery while retaining the real-user boundary.
2. Original runtime absence/refusal receipts remain unchanged. Exact authorized tool acquisition restored all four bound binary hashes. First new sandbox runtime attempt produced Node `spawnSync EPERM` and browser setup-process failures; all six failure outcomes remain under `video-fresh-run/`. The separately approved isolated process context, same pinned runtime and same unchanged fixture runner passed six cases under `video-fresh-run-attempt-2/`.
3. A full source/cache tree digest comparison initially failed. Independent inspection found eight directory permission normalizations across core/specialists; all file paths, contents and executable bits match. `native-cache-mode-observation.json` keeps this distinction. Full production tree digest equality is not claimed for these two packages. Video/execution source versus cache full tree digests do match. No canonical permission was changed.

## Evidence reuse and remaining acceptance

`lex12-{acceptance,noninstall-evidence,mobile-report-resolution}.json`, the earlier native-discovery assessment/debug/control files, retained-runtime verifier/manifest, execution engine oracle trials and source identities were read and are bound in `bindings.json`. The unchanged historical embedded-caption manifest and all97 resources/output files are independently rebound, preserving actual prior matting/render/composite/decoded pixel/audio evidence for the supplied-caption pipeline; no fresh matting or speech-model run is claimed. Earlier source hashes, packaging validation and narrower trial evidence remain reusable where unchanged; neither hashes nor the newer observations upgrade historical acceptance. The mobile transport correction qualifies named responses only and supplies no runtime/source-discovery substitute.

Remaining: complete package behavior/adoption decisions; required unavailable provider/workflow coverage; installed-user-host selection/migration/rollback acceptance in LEX-14–16; other OS/host/runtime dimensions. These are explicitly unresolved; this completed assessment does not mark the larger specification complete.

## Portable verification and preserved local context

`verify-original.mjs` preserves the initial verifier bytes; its SHA256 is recorded in `source-root-portability.json` and `bindings.json`. The current verifier finds the repository by walking upward to its package identity and registry marker, imports from that discovered root, and maps recorded `/github/skills` source references to the live checkout. Raw native/source captures retain their original factual paths.

Default portable verification always compares preserved before/final real-user control snapshots for equality. The named `--live-context-controls` check additionally reads those original machine paths and is optional because another machine does not own that live context. `source-root-portability.json` records a copied-path positive, missing-registry and unrelated-package negative controls, then restored success; the copied path includes spaces and `#`, and its CWD is elsewhere.

This root-path portability does not normalize historical source metadata. The strict preservation oracle still requires captured directory/file modes and fails on an environment or metadata mismatch. A published checkout with different directory modes can therefore fail this historical preservation oracle even with identical source file bytes. The separate release acceptance validator owns its declared Git-content/owner-executable portability semantics; this leaf does not relax its original preservation hashes or expand qualification scope.

## Four passes

1. Derived criteria from the adoption spec, root-run contract and exact prior records; inspected all invoked harnesses before execution.
2. Reused valid narrow evidence and supplied missing actual isolated native enumeration, projected relocated helper execution and exact pinned local video renders.
3. Checked actual source/cache file bindings and real-user controls; preserved rejected and failed attempts; separated directory mode normalization, runtime instrumentation and unsupported dimensions from accepted claims.
4. Reread the full assessment, bound source/runtime/evidence files, applied independent runnable oracles and prepared parent re-verification. No additional qualification claim remains unsupported within the stated bounded scope.
